landing.metaTitle: Vow – planer vjenčanja za parove koji se vjenčavaju preko granica
landing.metaDescription: Vaši gosti dolaze odasvud. Vow svakom gostu daje vlastitu stranicu putovanja, na njegovu jeziku, s letovima, sobama, mjestom za stolom i dokumentima za ulazak – sve na jednom mjestu.
landing.title: Vaši gosti dolaze odasvud. Vow ih dovodi do vas.
landing.intro: Jedan planer za par, obitelj u inozemstvu i svakog gosta: putovanja, sobe, raspored sjedenja, dokumenti i web-stranica, svakome na njegovom jeziku.
landing.featuresText: Svaki dio plana povezan je s ostalima. Potvrde idu u raspored sjedenja, rezervirana mjesta na vašu web-stranicu.

landing.closingText: Pozovite partnera, roditelje ili planera vjenčanja i planirajte sve zajedno u stvarnom vremenu, gdje god živjeli.

entry.title: Popis za ulazak za svakog gosta
entry.text: Putovnica, viza i putne dozvole za zemlju vjenčanja, prema zemlji svakog gosta, s kojeg god kontinenta dolazi.

rooms.title: Ploča hotelskih soba
rooms.text: Rezerviraj sobe u više hotela, rasporedi goste i prati tko je potvrdio, a kome još treba krevet.

shuttle.title: Planer prijevoza
shuttle.text: Grupirajte dolaske po vremenu, planirajte prijevoze i javite gostima kad im kreće prijevoz.

paperwork.title: Dokumenti za vjenčanje
paperwork.text: Dokumenti potrebni za zakonito vjenčanje u 64 zemlje: apostille, prijevodi, rokovi – sve na jednom mjestu.

languages.title: 25 jezika po gostu
languages.text: Vaša baka iz Slovenije sve vidi na slovenskom. Vaši prijatelji s faksa vide sve na engleskom. Automatski.

facts.title: Made for weddings that cross borders
facts.countries: countries’ marriage paperwork, step by step
facts.currencies: currencies side by side in your budget
facts.roles: ways to plan together: couple, family, planner and helpers

pricing.title: Free to plan your wedding
pricing.text: No trial, no card. Everything on this page is included.
pricing.priceNote: for the couple, the family and every guest

includes.guests: Guest list, RSVPs and seating chart
includes.trip: A trip page for every guest
includes.family: Plan together with family and your planner

free.a: Yes. You can plan your whole wedding in Vow, with your family and every guest, without paying.

guests.q: Do our guests need an account?
guests.a: No. Each household gets its own private link and code. They open it to reply, pick a meal and see their trip page.

languages.a: 25, including Slovenian, German, Croatian, Spanish and Arabic. Each guest sees their RSVP, trip page and emails in their own language.

family.a: Yes. Invite your partner, parents, planner or helpers. Each gets the right access, and everyone sees changes as they happen.

phone.q: Does it work on a phone?
phone.a: Yes. Vow is built for phones first, for you and for guests opening their link at the airport.

privacy.q: What happens to our guests’ data?
privacy.a: Only you and the people you invite can see it. Guests can see what you have saved about them and delete it themselves.

login.sentTo: Poslali smo e-poruku na {email}. Kliknite poveznicu u njoj (u ovom pregledniku) ili upišite kôd iz e-poruke ispod.
login.setupTitle: Skoro gotovo: Supabase još nije povezan.
login.setupText: Stvorite datoteku .env.local sa svojim Supabase URL-om i javnim ključem (vidi .env.example i README), zatim ponovno pokrenite npm run dev.
